main_text.head: XXVII. Non igitur hoc pacto grave & δυσβαστακτον jugum Mosis, denuò imponimus cervicibus Discipulorum Jesu Christi; qui liberati sunt à condemnatione Legis Moralis, ab onere omnium Cerimoniarum typicarum V. T. duráque illâ pædagogiâ.
main_text.p: Gratia & Veritas per Jesum Christum præstita est; Joh. 1, 17. qui consequenter jugum suum facile, & onus suum leve pronunciat, Matth. xi, 30. quemadmodùm etiàm Johannes i, v, 3. Mandata eius non sunt gravia. Promissis enim & consolationibus Euangelicis suaviter invitantur & excitantur fideles; & Spiritû gratiæ, adoptionis, sanctificationis, ac libertatis ità reguntur, ut sint populus voluntarius; Psal. cx, 3. cujus oblectatio in Lege Dei; Psal. i, 2. cxix, 6, 24, 47, 77, 92, 97, 103, 174. xl, 9. Rom. vii, 22. neq; solùm in reliquis Præceptis, sed specialiter etiàm in quarto; juxta illud Jes. lviii, 13, 14. Si averteris à Sabbatho pedem tuum, ne facias id quo delectaris die sancto meo; & vocaveris Sabbathum delicias, &c. Tunc oblectabis te in Jehovâ, &c. Sic ergò non gravia, sed suavia sunt nobis Præcepta

page.notes: Catchword-like word "pta" at lower right is the continuation of the last line; the text runs to the last full line. Show-through and stains omitted. Greek "δυσβαστακτον" is a reconstruction of the printed Greek word, which appears as "δυσβασ-τακτον" with partly illegible letters; marked as doubtful.
